title: Shared arrow data for nested affine chart formulas
statement:
Fix a finite purity setting $P$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber, det-sp-finite-general-ring], and use the ordinary small-etale constant-$P.Coefficient$ derived categories, their derived pullback and tensor and the shifted Tate objects [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom, def-weil-derived-tensor, def-coefficient-twists-detailed]. This node owns the already existing named constructions of lem-sp-nested-affine-orientation, relocated without changes to avoid an import cycle; it defines no second version of a notion.

For a morphism $f:X\to Y$, a structure map $a_Y:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}k$, and $m\ge0$, twistPull is the specified pullback isomorphism from $f^*P.diagonalTwistEtale(Y,m)$ to $P.diagonalTwistEtale(X,m)$. For a Noetherian scheme $S$ with structure map $a_S$, gammaUnit is the ordered affine counit transpose at the coefficient unit and gamma at a coefficient complex $H$ is the transpose of coefficient-first inverse projection followed by the normalized ordered trace [def-pur-diagonal-affine-trace-coordinates]. For smooth separated finite-type $f$ of relative dimension $d$, orientation is the inverse of the specified ordinary diagonal orientation [def-sp-nested-affine-orientation-coordinates]. For a smooth pair $f,g$ of dimensions $d,e$, source concatenates the ordered shifted Tate powers, interchanges the even blocks, and inserts the inverse of twistPull; tensorRoute then tensors the two inverse orientations and applies smoothPurityEtaleTheta [def-pur-smooth-purity-map].

Write $p_m:T_m(S)\to S$ for the ordered affine tower projection. The existing blockEq and blockProjection identify $T_d(T_e(S))$ with $T_{d+e}(S)$ and its composite projection. total is gammaUnit in rank $d+e$, pulled through this equality of schemes and through canonical etale dualizing locality. iterated is source, tensor of $q^*gammaUnit_e$ with the identity on the $d$-twist, gamma at $\omega_{p_e}$, and the inverse exceptional compositor [def-pur-finite-exceptional-composition]. mapEtale proves the etaleness of the affine base change of an etale map, and chartComposite records the composite chart equation. chartPull applies inverse twistPull, pullback of an affine arrow, canonical etale dualizing locality and the equality-induced target transport. zeroSource is the canonical identity-pullback and tensor-right-unit constraint.

NormalizedInputs is the proposition that for every affine finite-type $k$-scheme $B$ and $m\ge0$, orientation of $p_m$ equals gammaUnit, its dualizing object is constructible finite-Tor, and at every constructible finite-Tor $H$ both the tensor source and exceptional target are constructible finite-Tor, gamma is tensor of the identity with gammaUnit followed by theta, and gamma at rank zero is zeroSource under the exceptional-identity comparison. It also includes the corresponding rank-zero gammaUnit equation. Statement is the original nested-chart proposition: for a smooth pair and nested affine etale charts, the two restricted arrows equal chartPull of total and iterated respectively; these affine arrows, their pullbacks, and the restricted arrows agree; NormalizedInputs and the two dualizing input-domain claims hold; the block sign is $(-1)^{(2d)(2e)}=1$. All of these definitions and the four already proved geometric helpers retain their original signatures and bodies.
